# Diogo Lean Veiga — AI Systems & Product Architect
> Master’s in Human-Computer Interaction (ESDI/UERJ). Builder of autonomous multi-agent state machines, model-agnostic routing gateways, and high-throughput media synthesis pipelines.

## Canonical Projects
- [Aiwake](https://diogolean.com/projects/aiwake): Autonomous multi-agent dialectic friction runtime testing LLM guardrails, memory isolation, and emergent reasoning.
- [Omni-Engine](https://diogolean.com/omni-engine): High-concurrency media synthesis mesh scaled past 84.8M impressions at < $0.002 unit cost.
- [Endless Summer](https://diogolean.com/projects/endless_summer_paradise): Parametric generative video pipeline with procedural latent weighting.

## Core Technical Specs
- Languages & Runtimes: Python (Asyncio, ThreadPoolExecutor), React/Next.js, TypeScript.
- Agentic Stack: State Machine Routers, GraphRAG Context Isolation, Provider-Agnostic Model Gateways (Gemini, Claude, Llama, DeepSeek).
- Automation: Playwright CDP, Session/Cookie Persistence, Mutex Write-Locks, Backblaze B2.
